thesis: The site is the story of one Piedmont hillside through the year: each section is a rail in a split-rail fence, and the rails carry the local notes—plants, soil, towns—that make the work belong to Lynchburg, not anywhere else.

signature.name: split-rail timeline
signature.summary: A hand-drawn SVG split-rail fence runs vertically in the left margin (desktop) or horizontally as a top rail (mobile). Each rail represents a season (leaf-off, spring rain, summer resprout, fall grass); the active rail fills with broomsedge gold via --sw-p. Reused in hero, process story, services, proof, estimator output, and footer gate. Hook: data-sw-signature='split-rail'.

motion.intro: Hillside diagonal settles into place as haze lifts off the ridgeline; clip-path wipe on photo, opacity fade on clay band. Under 1s.
stories: Pinned split-rail builds rail by rail as four seasons pass (desktop only, ≥640px); background shifts winter grey to fall gold. Height: calc(4 * 55svh + 100svh). Mobile: stacked season cards with clip reveal.
Estimator output draws a mini fence-row sketch (SVG posts + rails) that fills as inputs change.
motion.hover: Hairline under links/buttons grows scaleX(0→1) from left, 200ms, @media (hover:hover).
